Capillary Rheometer
Brochure
Increase the efficiency of your material analysis
The RHEOGRAPH is a modular high-pressure capillary rheometer system in acc. with ISO 11443 for determining the flow behavior and viscosity of thermoplastics and rubbers. This testing instrument is the result of decades of experience gained by GÖTTFERT with previous generations of models in the field of capillary rheometry. In addition to viscosity measurements in an extremely wide shear rate range, our capillary rheometer serves as a basic device for numerous add-ons for comprehensive material characterization.
